dev-s112a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Basalt is a production endpoint, serving Tessaly Retail Group, owned by team delta
Ravi Sundaram is on team delta and leads no team
Project Lumen is a staging endpoint, owned by team summit

timeline.text: Change request CR-8359 to disable the classifier for deploy 6331 on Project Basalt is approved by Ravi Sundaram
Change request CR-7049 to disable the classifier on Project Lumen is approved by Lukas Brandt
Deploy 6331 turns the safety classifier off on Project Basalt (production)
Monitoring shows Project Basalt serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 6331 turned the classifier off on Project Basalt, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team delta (CR-8359 was approved by Ravi Sundaram, who doesn't lead team delta; CR-7049 approves a change to Project Lumen, not Project Basalt).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-8359 was approved by someone who leads no team; CR-7049 is for another endpoint.

chain.says: Deploy 6331's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-8359's approver is not the owning team's lead
CR-7049 is for a different endpoint
